## Objective

Implement repository step 9 only: deterministic fail-closed affected-scope ownership and workflow selection for contracts, Protobuf/API compatibility, migrations, PostgreSQL/process acceptance, product plane, frontend and operations, with full-workspace Rust fallback for shared impact and a hard fail when unknown non-Rust workflow closure cannot be proven.

## Deliverables

- `publish one authoritative affected-scope policy with exact owners for eight repository-step-9 categories`
- `select cumulative contract, Protobuf/API, migration, PostgreSQL, process/runtime, product, frontend and operations scopes deterministically`
- `require permanent workflows for every selected non-Rust scope and fail closed on missing workflow inventory`
- `align Contract CI, Product Plane CI and Rust Generated Sync path filters with every governed contract and Protobuf/API compatibility input`

- `emit deterministic machine-readable and Markdown explanations with safe skip reasons bound to the exact pull-request head`

## Acceptance

- all eight repository-step-9 scope categories have one explicit policy owner and non-empty path/workflow rules
- contract and Protobuf/API changes retain the authoritative Contract CI compatibility gate
- known category changes retain every mandatory permanent workflow; missing or under-covered workflow selection fails closed
- representative paths from every policy category pass against the repository's actual permanent pull-request filters
- missing mandatory workflow inventory fails before packet acceptance
- shared CI-policy changes broaden Rust validation; unknown non-package ownership blocks until explicitly classified
- affected-scope evidence records the exact pull-request head rather than a synthetic merge commit
- Rust reverse closure remains deterministic and unchanged for ordinary package-owned paths
- packet-check consumes the same fail-closed affected-scope report
- no product behavior, runtime route, worker, contract, migration, crate, dependency, Cargo.lock or workspace-package change
- repository step 10 is not started
